nodes.label: Chat turn
nodes.summary: A message typed in a chat runs one headless `claude -p` turn whose events stream back live into the chat feed.

nodes.label: Compose and send
nodes.summary: The composer sends the text plus any attached map-node references to the server.

nodes.label: Resolve message context
nodes.summary: POST /api/chats/:id/messages titles a new chat and resolves attached node refs against the map files on disk.

nodes.label: Spawn claude -p
nodes.summary: startTurn records a run, builds the context block, and spawns the CLI with the Flightdeck hook, the chat's mode/model, and no API key in its environment.

nodes.label: Parse event stream
nodes.summary: Each stream-json line is validated; a non-subscription session is killed by the tripwire, everything else is appended to the feed.

nodes.label: Append to feed
nodes.summary: Feed items go to the chat's append-only JSONL file and to every live subscriber.

nodes.label: Stream feed (SSE)
nodes.summary: GET /api/chats/:id/feed replays the whole JSONL, marks 'replayed', then pushes live items with keep-alive pings.

nodes.label: Render feed
nodes.summary: The chat's EventSource collects items and derive() folds them into messages, tool activities and approval cards.

nodes.label: Stop button
nodes.summary: POST /api/chats/:id/stop cancels open approval cards and SIGINTs the claude process.

nodes.label: Finish run
nodes.summary: On process close the run is marked finished/failed/stopped, the edit lock released and pending cards cancelled.

nodes.label: Tool approval
nodes.summary: Every tool call the chat's claude makes is held at Flightdeck's PreToolUse hook and decided by mode, edit lock, project rules, or a card the user clicks.

nodes.label: Hook endpoint
nodes.summary: POST /hook parses Claude Code's payload and answers with a PreToolUse permission decision.

nodes.label: Mode and lock check
nodes.summary: Edits are refused in Discuss mode, and refused when another chat in the project holds the edit lock.

nodes.label: Evaluate rules
nodes.summary: The project's allow/ask/deny rules (Claude Code syntax, deny > ask > allow, every part of a shell command checked) bucket the call.

nodes.label: Hold approval card
nodes.summary: An 'ask' verdict records a pending approval, shows a card in the feed and holds the hook until a click or timeout.

nodes.label: Click allow/deny
nodes.summary: The approval card lets the user allow once, deny with a reason, or save an 'always allow' pattern.

nodes.label: Resolve approval
nodes.summary: POST /api/approvals/:id settles the pending card, optionally saves the rule, and releases the held hook with the answer.

nodes.label: Save allow rule
nodes.summary: An 'always allow' pattern becomes a new allow rule in the project's rules table.

nodes.label: Map generation
nodes.summary: 'Map this project' runs a read-only claude agent with a JSON schema and stores the validated diagram in .flightdeck/<view>.json.

nodes.label: Request generation
nodes.summary: The Map screen's button posts to the generate endpoint and starts polling the job.

nodes.label: Generate endpoint
nodes.summary: POST /api/projects/:id/maps/:view/generate starts a job, one per project at a time.

nodes.label: Spawn mapping agent
nodes.summary: startGeneration spawns claude with the view prompt, --json-schema, disallowed write tools, a scratch git index and the /hook/map hook.

nodes.label: Read-only hook
nodes.summary: POST /hook/map allows only reading, searching and git inspection, denying everything else without cards.

nodes.label: Validate map
nodes.summary: The structured output is schema-checked, then validateMap rejects structural errors and drops nonexistent files, bad edges and bad citations.

nodes.label: Write map file
nodes.summary: The map is stored with the HEAD commit(s) it was made from in the project's maps directory.

nodes.label: Browse a map
nodes.summary: The Map screen loads a stored map with change detection, lays out one level at a time, and opens the files and chats behind nodes.

nodes.label: Load and poll map
nodes.summary: useMap fetches the view and re-polls (2s while generating, 15s otherwise).

nodes.label: Map endpoint
nodes.summary: GET /api/projects/:id/maps/:view reads the map file and attaches stale nodes, changed files and the job status.

nodes.label: Detect changes
nodes.summary: changedSince diffs against the map's commit(s) on a scratch index, and staleNodeIds marks nodes covering changed files plus their ancestors.

nodes.label: Lift edges and lay out
nodes.summary: liftEdges re-targets edges to the visible level and ELK computes positions and orthogonal routes for React Flow.

nodes.label: Open file viewer
nodes.summary: The viewer fetches a node's file or folder and shows it highlighted, with links back to the nodes covering it.

nodes.label: Read file safely
nodes.summary: GET /api/projects/:id/file returns a file or directory listing, refusing paths outside the project or inside .git.

nodes.label: Discuss in new chat
nodes.summary: 'Discuss in a new chat' creates a chat and hands the selected node to it as initial context.

nodes.label: Chat map pane
nodes.summary: Beside a chat, the map lights up the files the latest run read or edited and lets the user attach nodes to the next message.

nodes.label: Collect touched files
nodes.summary: derive() records which repo-relative paths the latest run read or successfully edited.

nodes.label: Heat map nodes
nodes.summary: nodesForFile maps each touched file to its most specific covering nodes, colored read or edited.

nodes.label: Attach node
nodes.summary: Clicking a node toggles it as a context chip on the composer.

nodes.label: Create project
nodes.summary: A brand-new project gets a git-initialized folder, template rules, and a Build chat that scaffolds the chosen stack.

nodes.label: New project form
nodes.summary: The sidebar form collects name, folder under the browse root, stack and description.

nodes.label: Create endpoint
nodes.summary: POST /api/projects/new checks the folder is new and under the browse root, then runs git init.

nodes.label: Insert project + rules
nodes.summary: insertProject stores the project with default models and copies TEMPLATE_RULES as its own rules.

nodes.label: Start scaffold turn
nodes.summary: A Build-mode chat is created and its first turn runs the stack's scaffold prompt.

nodes.label: Add existing project
nodes.summary: The user browses folders under ~/dev and registers a git repository (or a folder of repositories) as a project.

nodes.label: Folder browser
nodes.summary: The browser walks folders and offers 'Choose' on ones that are, or contain, git repositories.

nodes.label: Browse endpoint
nodes.summary: GET /api/browse lists subfolders after resolving symlinks, confined to the browse root.

nodes.label: Add endpoint
nodes.summary: POST /api/projects validates the path is an existing repo (or folder of repos) not already added, then inserts it.

nodes.label: Serve and admit
nodes.summary: The server starts its listeners (optionally launched by the Mac app) and admits a request only from loopback names or the SSO gateway's secret.

nodes.label: Mac app launch
nodes.summary: Flightdeck.app starts the server as its child with settings from Info.plist, opens the browser when /health answers, and stops it on quit.

nodes.label: Start listeners
nodes.summary: serve() binds the loopback port, an optional port-80 forwarding target, and an optional gateway listener.

nodes.label: Loopback guard
nodes.summary: refuseLocal requires a local Host name and, for writes, a local Origin and JSON body, blocking DNS rebinding and cross-site requests.

nodes.label: Gateway secret check
nodes.summary: The gateway listener 404s /hook paths and requires the X-Flightdeck-Gateway secret via a timing-safe compare.

nodes.label: Hono app
nodes.summary: Admitted requests reach the Hono API routes and the built web app served from dist/.
